wargear.name: Strategos slate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cogitator slate loaded with the Codex's battle-plans and the day's terrain surveys. The model gains +1 Cool and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Praetorian hoplon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall tower shield blazoned with the Ultramar omega. Every model in the unit has a 4+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse.

wargear.name: Ultramar fire-control array
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Range-finders and a dedicated gunnery cogitator, run to Ultramar tolerances. The vehicle gains +1 Ballistic Skill.

option.text: The Sergeant may take an Ultramar pattern weapon
Up to three Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
The unit may carry Praetorian hoplons
May be fitted with an Ultramar fire-control array
The Strike Leader may exchange the Argean power sword for

modifiers.text: Drilled to the Codex: +1 LD, -1 I.
Eagles of the storm: +1 WS, -1 T.

rites.name: The Five Hundred Muster
rites.flavor: Every world of Ultramar sends its sons, and every son has drilled the same manoeuvres since boyhood.
rites.text: Veteran Tactical Squads and Praetorian Breacher Squads may fill Troops slots. Tactical Squads cost 10 points less. At least two Tactical Squads and a Centurion are required. The Muster does not improvise: no Fast Attack units and no model with the Antigrav type.

require.note: Bring at least two Tactical Squads.
A Centurion must lead the Muster.

rites.name: Phalanx of the Invictus
rites.flavor: Behind the shield-wall of the Suzerains, the rest of the Legion simply refuses to die.
rites.text: Invictus Suzerain Squads may fill Troops slots, cost 20 points less and gain +1 Cool. At least one Invictus Suzerain Squad is required. A phalanx marches at the pace of its shields: no War Engines and no Lord of War units.

require.note: Bring at least one Invictus Suzerain Squad.

rites.name: Strike of the Locutarus
rites.flavor: A line of retros against the clouds, and the Eagles of Macragge are already on the roof.
rites.text: Locutarus Storm Squads may fill Troops slots and cost 25 points less. Their pilots gain +1 Initiative and -1 Leadership. At least one Locutarus Storm Squad is required. The Eagles fight light: no Armour units and no War Engines.

modifiers.text: Strike of the Locutarus: +1 I, -1 LD.

require.note: Bring at least one Locutarus Storm Squad.

rites.name: Remember Calth
rites.flavor: The Legion was shot in the back by its own brothers, and has not yet finished answering.
rites.text: Every Ultramarines unit gains Hatred (Word Bearers) and +1 Leadership. The Honoured Telemechrus costs 30 points less. Remus Ventanus must lead the army. Grief leaves no room for hired knives: no Assassins and no Malefic models.

require.note: Remus Ventanus must lead the army.
